name: Session Stats
description: Live overlay with your attempts, deaths, session best and play time.

show-overlay.name: Show Overlay
show-overlay.description: Show the stats overlay while playing a level.

position.name: Position
position.description: Which corner of the screen the overlay sits in.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: How see-through the overlay is (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).

best-popup.name: New Best Popup
best-popup.description: Flash a "NEW BEST" message when you beat your session best.
